boardLastUpdatedNote: Latest entry in the page's own Changelog ('Oct 28, 2026: Added Gemini 4 Carbon.'). The board shows no explicit 'last updated' stamp. data.json HTTP Last-Modified: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 13:46:59 GMT (server header, not a board statement).

scoring.score: Score is a weighted aggregate of the rubric items. Solutions that don't pass blocking criteria receive 0; runs flagged for unfair internet use receive 0 (board text).
scoring.passRate: Field 'correct': fraction of trials satisfying every blocker rubric criterion (all-or-nothing per trial), averaged over tasks.
scoring.cost: Field 'cost': mean USD spend per rollout at list API pricing, including public discounts (board label 'Cost / rollout'). Per rollout = one attempt on one task.
scoring.flaggedRate: Fraction of runs flagged for unfair internet use (each scored 0).
scoring.headlineRanking: The default table and ld+json top-10 rank each model at its best-scoring effort (max new_score across efforts); a per-effort view lists every (model, effort) row.

runsPerTaskNote: Not stated for the board. The blog/page sample-task widgets show 5 runs per (model, effort) on the illustrated tasks (e.g. 'Claude Opus 5.5 low: 0/5 runs passed'); not stated as the general protocol, so runsN is null on every row.
historicalLineageNote: Board JS excludes these from the default top list; changelog Oct 27, 2026: 'Added historical results ... shown in the lineage animation on hover.' They remain in data.json.
otherFieldsNull: duration_min, tool_calls, ote are null for every 2.0 row; steps absent.
blogCrossCheck: Blog table (2026-10-27) lists SWE-2 23.9%; data.json (Last-Modified 2026-10-31) gives SWE-2 max 23.8%. All other blog 2.0 values checked match. Third-party mirror benchlm.ai/benchmarks/frontiercode-2 shows the same best-effort values (e.g. GPT-6 Sol max 34.3%, SWE-2 max 23.8%); mirrors used only as a cross-check.
